decision.title: No-inherit for the top element of a copy (P6)

body.p: by packet , on the orchestrator's acceptance of P6 (design edit to include/sxml/tree.h). sxml_element_start_event gains bool ignores_parent_namespaces: true makes the element start from the xml binding alone (plus its own bindings and fixup), not from its parent's in-scope namespaces. Named so that zero, the default of every existing designated initializer, keeps inheriting (P6 had proposed inherits_namespaces defaulting to true, which zero cannot express). sxml_tree_builder_copy_node sets it on the copy's top element when inherits_namespaces is false (XQuery 4.0 copy-namespaces no-inherit); descendants inherit from the top element as usual. The arena tree honours it when it computes the header element's inherited list.
